newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end slightly off in anemic trade.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end slightly off in anemic trade.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed slightly lower Tuesday as investors generally stayed on the sidelines waiting for more attractive prices, brokers said.
They added the market would likely be mixed Wednesday as prices in the telecommunications sector had reached their floor while the brewery sector would probably see further falls.
Tuesday, the General Index IGRA fell 0.40 percent to 1,538.4 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index ISEL dipped 0.11 percent to 2,215.9 points.

In a total of 1,632 trades, volume was a meager 25.4 million soles ($9.7 million). Two cross-trades -- or trades within the same brokerage -- accounted for about 40 percent of the session's total trade.

"The funds coming into the market were mainly local. The market continued its technical correction although in a less pronounced form than on previous days," said Flavio Campos of local brokerage Finanzas y Valores. "At these levels there are many stocks that start to become attractive."

Among leaders, Telefnica del Per rose 0.52 percent to 5.79 soles in volume of 768,000 shares. The country's largest brewery Backus y Jonhston fell 0.88 percent to 2.24 soles in volume of 3.1 million shares.
